metadata.title: Affiliate programme
metadata.description: How the SaaSy Land affiliate programme pays commission, how referrals are recorded, and how you can check every sale yourself.

title: Affiliate programme
description: Recommend SaaSy Land and earn {commission}% of every sale you refer. Clicks, orders, refunds and payouts are recorded by Affonso, an independent affiliate platform, so you can check every number yourself.

commission.title: Commission
commission.body: You earn {commission}% of every order placed through your link, on every licence tier. Commission is calculated on the amount the buyer paid after any discount, including regional pricing, and before sales tax or VAT.

attribution.title: How referrals are recorded
attribution.body: Your link can point to any SaaSy Land page, for example saasyland.com/?via=your-name. When someone opens it, Affonso records the click and stores a referral cookie in their browser for {cookieDays} days. Every order that person places in that time is credited to you, because checkout attaches the referral to the Polar order. If they later open another affiliate's link, the most recent link is credited.

verification.title: Numbers you can check
verification.body: We do not count referrals ourselves. Affonso records each click when your link is opened, and Polar, our payment provider and merchant of record, sends every order and refund straight to Affonso. The referral is stored on the order, and Polar does not let us change an order's amount or metadata once it is paid. Your Affonso dashboard lists every click, order and refund, and the status of each commission.

payouts.title: Payouts
payouts.body: Each commission stays pending for {holdDays} days, which is longer than the 14-day EU withdrawal period, and is then approved. Approved commissions are paid monthly through Affonso by PayPal or bank transfer once your balance reaches {minimumPayout}. Any fee your bank or PayPal charges for receiving the payment is yours.

refunds.title: Refunds and chargebacks
refunds.body: When an order is refunded or charged back, its commission is cancelled or reduced by the refunded amount. The {holdDays}-day hold exists so that refunds settle before anything is paid.

rules.title: Fair play
rules.body: A commission is declined when the referral breaks one of these rules: buying through your own link, bidding on the SaaSy Land name in paid search ads, promising discounts or features that do not exist, or sending unsolicited messages. Everything else is welcome, including reviews, tutorials, videos, newsletters, marketplace listings and comparison pages.

buyers.title: What buyers pay
buyers.body: Buyers pay the same price with or without your link, and regional pricing still applies. Your link only records who recommended SaaSy Land.

changes.title: Changes to these terms
changes.body: A change to these terms applies only to clicks recorded after it is published on this page. Commission you have already earned is never reduced by a change.

join.title: How to join
join.body: Email {email} and tell us where you plan to share SaaSy Land. You will receive an invitation to your Affonso dashboard, where you get your link and choose how you are paid.
